initialize_qinco_codebooks: initialize QINCo model codebook weights from RQ centroids with configurable noise
QConcat_forward: run the QConcat module to concatenate and transform codeword and residual tensors
QBlockFFN_forward: run a residual FFN block with up projection, ReLU, and down projection
QINCoStep_encode: encode input vectors through a QINCo quantization step with beam search and substep candidates
QINCo_forward: run the QINCo quantizer in train, encode, or decode mode on input tensors
